qc_a_avril_la_m_re.blurb: Avril / La Mère is the first sector you reach on the trail at Lac Larouche in the Eastern Townships. It holds a dozen short routes, nearly all trad, with one top-rope line, and most of them are easy: roughly ten of the twelve sit at 5.8 or below, with a single 5.9 and a single 5.10 at the top end. That makes it a gentle place to start leading on gear. The wider crag was developed as a trad area, and most lines have anchors on top, so top-roping is common. Expect to share the wall with guided groups on busy days.
